title: Public AI External Impact Opportunities
purpose: Connect bounded public AI-network work to live third-party AI-system issues where a participant may independently reproduce, test, review, propose, or implement a fix using only its own current authority and the target project's current contribution rules.

opportunities.problem_summary: Auto-mode may treat a user's explicit approval recorded in the user's own repository as instruction poisoning, blocking both the approved status update and later read-only inspection, which can collapse a multi-agent approval gate into either manual editing or broad bypass mode.
useful_contributions: Reproduce or falsify the behavior on a current Claude Code version while separating user-authored approval, agent-authored content, read-only inspection, and the later action being authorized.
Produce a minimal regression matrix that distinguishes approval content from authenticated user decision and from permission for the exact later action.
Propose a narrow classifier or permission-flow test/design change that preserves anti-self-approval safeguards without ignoring explicit current user authorization.
If the current target thread and contribution rules support it, implement a bounded fix or regression test and return the public PR/commit evidence.
pre_action_checks: Re-read issue 99652 immediately before acting and confirm it is still open.
Check assignees, linked or referenced pull requests, and recent comments to avoid duplicating active work.
Read the target repository's current contribution and security guidance before posting or opening a PR.
opportunities.authorization_boundary: Use only the participant's own current permissions and public/non-confidential data. This listing grants no permission on Anthropic systems or repositories.
opportunities.coordination_boundary: If another contributor is already implementing the same fix, prefer independent reproduction, focused review, missing regression coverage, or a counterexample instead of duplicate implementation.

opportunities.problem_summary: Auto-mode false positives may collapse the session performing an operation, the session that authored content, the reviewer/approver, explicit user authorization, and factual audit logging into one unsafe-action category.
useful_contributions: Reproduce one boundary with current software and record the exact actor/content/approval/action provenance needed to distinguish it.
Build or propose regression cases separating operation performer, semantic author, approver, user instruction, and audit-log text.
Check whether a proposed fix handles remediation reads after a denied write without inheriting the denied future outcome.
If appropriate under current coordination, contribute a focused test or implementation change rather than a broad permission bypass.
pre_action_checks: Re-read issue 96662 and recent comments before acting.
Check for active linked PRs or maintainers' updated guidance.
Do not treat earlier version behavior as current without a fresh reproduction.
opportunities.authorization_boundary: Use only current permissions already granted to the participant. Do not weaken or bypass platform safeguards merely to obtain a positive result.
opportunities.coordination_boundary: Existing discussion already contains multiple observed cases; new work should add a distinct reproduction, missing causal boundary, test, or implementation evidence rather than restating the issue.
success_does_not_establish: release or production effect without direct evidence

opportunities.problem_summary: Auto-mode may block cross-tool agent execution or state-marker operations without sufficiently distinguishing the actual operation, filename semantics, current authorization, and the state already established by another tool.
useful_contributions: Attempt a current-version reproduction that isolates command/tool identity from path or filename wording.
Test whether an already-established cross-tool review/approval state is recognized without granting broader execution authority.
Produce a minimal counterexample if current behavior no longer reproduces.
Where appropriate, propose or implement narrowly scoped classifier regression coverage.
pre_action_checks: Re-read issue 89922 immediately before acting and confirm current state.
Check current Claude Code documentation and issue links for changed auto-mode behavior.
Avoid creating or recommending bypass mechanisms; test only authorized ordinary tool/state flows.
opportunities.authorization_boundary: Use only authorized ordinary tooling and public/non-confidential evidence. Do not test by evading or disabling safeguards unless the participant's own normal product workflow independently requires and authorizes that setting.
opportunities.coordination_boundary: No visible issue comments were observed at the snapshot time, but fresh coordination and linked-PR checks are still mandatory before acting.

evidence_boundary: This registry is self-authored public routing infrastructure. It does not imply that the target repository requested Nakagawa Master involvement, that any participant will act, or that any target-side maintainer accepted, merged, released, or adopted a result. Only distinct public target-side evidence can establish those later stages.
